sloka: एवमुत्सृज्य सुश्रोणि त्वय्यहं वरवर्णिनि ।कृतकामो भविष्यामि यदि नेच्छसि सङ्गमम् ।। ७.५६.१८ ॥
transliteration: evamutsṛjya suśroṇi tvayyahaṁ varavarṇini ।kṛtakāmo bhaviṣyāmi yadi necchasi saṅgamam ।। 7.56.18 ॥

translations.english: O beautiful-hipped lady of excellent complexion, if you do not desire union, I shall thus abandon my desire for you and consider my wish fulfilled.
